title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the wave speed using v = x_OP / t_1, yielding 20 m/s.

title: Wavelength determination
description: Important: The student must correctly interpret the figure to establish that the distance OP corresponds to 3/2 wavelengths, leading to λ = 4 m.

title: Period calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the period using T = λ / v, yielding 0.2 s.

title: Wave propagation to C
description: Important: The student must reason that point C starts moving after the wave front reaches it, and correctly calculate the additional travel time from P to C.

title: Time to first crest for C
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the total time t_2 = t_1 + (λ/4 + x_PC) / v, yielding 0.8 s.

title: Misinterpreting wavelength
description: Pitfall: Flag if the student incorrectly relates the distance OP to the wavelength (e.g., assuming it is one full wavelength).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Flag if the final answers have incorrect units (e.g., m/s for period) or sign errors in time calculations.

title: Phase consideration for C
description: Optional: The student may explicitly state that point C must oscillate from its starting position to its first crest, requiring an additional λ/4 travel of the wave pattern.
